caption: The drawing depicts a round, metallic container with a hinged lid that is open, revealing the interior of the container. The container and its lid are rendered in shades of gray, blue, and brown, giving it a weathered, metallic appearance. The ellipse-shaped lid is attached to the main body with a hinge, and both the inside and outside of the lid display concentric circular patterns. On the left and right upper corners of the drawing, there are two square insets showing the top and bottom views of the object at half actual size, as indicated in handwritten text below each inset. The main image of the container occupies the center of the composition and is labeled “actual size.” The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular frame and set against a plain, off-white or beige background. The artist's signature “A. Walbeck” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Snuff Box
